title: He started a computing REVOLUTION—then the shortage hit
summary: Jeff Geerling interviews Raspberry Pi co-founder Eben Upton about the Pi shortage, the RP2040, RISC-V, the Sony investment and the origin of the name.
why: HN recommends it to explain why Pi supply favored business customers during the shortage, straight from a founder.

quote.text: This interview with one of the founders from Jeff Geerling was quite insightful, definitely check it out if you haven't already!
